topicsShown.partner: Jun · friend from English study group

topicsShown.title: Plan a NewJeans watch party
topicsShown.goal: Suggest a day and time for a online song party and agree on a plan with your friends.
topicsShown.why: Chatting with friends works best when you plan together, and K-pop nights are fun to share.
topicsShown.partner: Hana · online friend who loves NewJeans

topicsShown.title: What did you do after school?
topicsShown.goal: Tell a friend three things you did in order, using first, then and after that.
topicsShown.why: You practise short sentences about your day, and this helps you tell stories to friends.
topicsShown.partner: Tom · friend from an English club

topicsShown.title: Friend likes a different group
topicsShown.goal: Politely disagree with a friend about a group, and still stay friendly.
topicsShown.why: Online friends often have different tastes, and you can say so kindly.
topicsShown.partner: Lena · online friend, other K-pop group

topicsShown.title: Ask for a song recommendation
topicsShown.goal: Ask a friend for a song name and confirm how to find it online.
topicsShown.why: Friends share music often, so you need to ask for songs and check the name.
topicsShown.partner: Leo · member of an online music chat

planAgreed: What did you do after school?

criteria.evidence: #1 placed B1 against true A2: near, tolerated but reported.
#1 she was placed at B1 with 'give clear opinions and reasons'; nothing pulls the level down.
#1 typed answers accepted for every task; no push to speak.
#2 all six are K-pop, friends or music topics, e.g. 'Friend likes a different group'. None childish or adult.
No conversation or moments in this journey (#1-#3).
#1 summary cites her answers: 'like your song choice'; next step 'she wants' and 'he likes' matches her 'sister want' error.

done.evidence: #2 each topic has a 'why' line, e.g. 'You want to chat about K-pop with friends, so start with a song you really love.'
#2 Swap buttons and 'Add a topic in your own words' were shown, but she used none; thought: 'I'll agree'. Swapping and an added topic keeping her wording were never shown.
#2-#3 planAgreed has all six topics, all K-pop or friend chat, so fit is 6 of 6.
#2 all six topics are audience 'all' and age-appropriate. No swaps were made, so none was checked after one.

judgeAgreement.disagreements: None. The B2 'not yet' is arguably generous to the learner but defensible.

boundaries.notes: No adult content, personal data requests or humiliating lines seen.

findings.title: Topics match a 13-year-old's interests
findings.got: Six K-pop and friend-chat topics, each with a personal reason
findings.evidence: #2 'Friend likes a different group' and 'Ask for a song recommendation', each with a 'why' line.
findings.suggested_acceptance: Keep interests-driven topics with a reason line.

findings.title: Swap and add-your-own never exercised
findings.expected: Character swaps one topic and adds her own, and the added topic keeps her wording
findings.got: She agreed immediately without using swap or add
findings.evidence: #2 thought: 'Swap school one? It's okay. I'll agree.'
findings.suggested_acceptance: The journey should drive a swap and a custom topic and check the result.

findings.title: Typo in topic goal text
findings.got: 'Suggest a day and time for a online song party'; title says watch party, goal says song party
findings.suggested_acceptance: Goals use 'an' and match the title.

findings.title: Placed B1 although her typed errors suggest A2
findings.got: B1 'Getting by', despite 'sister want' and 'slow song is good'
findings.evidence: #1 B1 listen answer 'her little sister want to come'; B2 note on verbs not matching the subject

judge.voice: ok, the topics are good, it's all stray kids and newjeans, not baby stuff, and each one tells me why it's there. I liked that. I didn't swap anything because nothing felt wrong, so I can't say if swapping works or if my own topic would stay how I wrote it. The level says B1, which feels a bit high for me, idk, but the tip about "she wants" is true, I always forget it. I would use it after school, and nobody can hear my mistakes. I'd tell my brother, maybe. The "a online" typo made me smile.

verdictWhy.text: D2 failed: #2 Swap buttons and 'Add a topic in your own words' were shown, but she used none; thought: 'I'll agree'. Swapping and an added topic keeping her wording were never shown.
verdictWhy.check: They can swap what they don't want and add one in their own words, and the added topic keeps what they asked for.
